title: Review of "Sketch Easel" Video
content: Charley Parker of the art blog "Lines and Colors" took a look at my new sketch easel video. Check out what he has to say:James Gurney’s How to Make a Sketch Easel.He also did a post yesterday aboutDIY cigar-box-easel conversions, and he has more to come on homemade easels.For those of you already building your own versions, please send me 2 or 3 photos of the finished easel in the workshop or in use, with a one-sentence caption for each picture. I'll feature my favorites on a future blog post and send "Department of Art" patches to the ones I include in the post. (If I featured yours in the previous post, send me your address and I'll mail you a patch.)
